claims.exact_claim: On one Windows RTX 4050 host and 100k x 384 AG News rows, all-row completed-call P95 was 16.6567 ms for Qenlo CPU, 3.2404 ms for WGPU predicate, 4.2428 ms for WGPU compact rows, and 4.4591 ms for WGPU mask.
claims.hardware_software: Windows 11; Intel Core i5-13420H, 12 logical processors, 16.87 GiB RAM; NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop, 6141 MiB, driver 616.56; Rust 1.98 release, clang-cl, wgpu DX12.
claims.dataset_provenance: DTU AG News all-MiniLM-L12-v2 embeddings; 100000 corpus rows x 384 FP32; corpus/tuning/evaluation ranges disjoint; synthetic independent metadata; source record benchmarks/2026-08-28/real/dataset/ag-news-384.json.
claims.timing_boundary: Batch-call completion from host search invocation until ordered IDs/distances are available; includes predicate, transfer, dispatch, synchronization, readback, and merge; excludes build/load/oracle.
claims.samples_repetitions: 5 runs x 5000 held-out queries per run; report is lower-middle run P95.
claims.correctness_oracle: Independent FP64 exhaustive oracle; evaluation recall 0.99998 for exact native paths; zero filter violations; USearch/Chroma are separate approximate rows.
claims.memory_scope: Vector/gpu budgets in config; host RSS and allocator unavailable in this cohort; owned accelerator scope is not physical VRAM.
claims.qualification: Qualified within this hardware/revision/workload; exhaustive paths are exhaustive but not numerically identical to FP64 at all boundaries.
claims.limitations: One laptop, one OS/API, D=384, B=1, all rows; the dense WGPU predicate/rows/mask rows share `f1ccc4d...`, while the CPU dense row records `4ae9f1d...`; Chroma boundary differs and ANN rows are not an exact comparison; working tree was dirty.
claims.recommendation: Retain as Windows dense representation/crossover context; never relabel as new-campaign or universal database ranking.

claims.exact_claim: On the same Windows corpus at E=1000 (1% eligible), CPU P95 was 0.2304 ms, compact-row WGPU 0.6766 ms, and shader-predicate WGPU 2.8832 ms; all had recall 1.0.
claims.hardware_software: Windows 11 / Core i5-13420H / RTX 4050 laptop / DX12; Rust release build.
claims.dataset_provenance: Same DTU AG News 100k x 384 source and synthetic independent metadata as dense endpoint; filter user_id=0 and timestamp range -50000..-49000.
claims.timing_boundary: Completed host batch call; compact rows include predicate traversal/materialization and GPU transfer.
claims.samples_repetitions: 5 runs x 5000 evaluation calls; lower-middle P95.
claims.correctness_oracle: Independent FP64 oracle; recall 1.0; zero filter violations.
claims.memory_scope: Host RSS/allocator unavailable; config vector budget is admission scope only.
claims.qualification: Qualified exact/exhaustive result within the cell.
claims.limitations: Selective filter is one synthetic metadata distribution; no B>1; the CPU/compact-row sparse rows record `78e3947...`, while shader-predicate records `f1ccc4d...`; compact-row and predicate representations differ in work.
claims.recommendation: Use to support selectivity and representation dependence; do not combine with 100k dense P95 into a pooled effect.

claims.exact_claim: The post-hoc RTX 4050 compact-row sweep brackets a CPU/WGPU winner reversal between E=2000 and E=3000: CPU/WGPU P95 ratios are 0.8199, 1.1742, 1.2392, 1.2309, 1.1625, and 1.0792 for E=2k,3k,4k,6k,8k,10k.

claims.dataset_provenance: Same 100k x 384 AG News source, synthetic independent metadata, disjoint tuning/evaluation ranges.

claims.exact_claim: Applying the shipped 4096-row static rule counterfactually to the six crossover cells misroutes E=3000 and E=4000, with relative P95 regret 17.4239% and 23.9173%; it selects the measured fastest route in the other four cells.
claims.hardware_software: Same RTX 4050 Windows cohort as native crossover.
claims.dataset_provenance: Same 100k x 384 AG News and predicate cells.

parameters.policy: CPU if E<4096 else compact-row WGPU

claims.timing_boundary: Cell-level P95 only; policy is applied after observing measured cell results; no per-query paired route trace.
claims.qualification: Post-hoc counterfactual analysis; not a calibrated-router evaluation.
claims.limitations: Only two misroutes in six points; no held-out policy; no uncertainty interval; absolute regret is descriptive.
claims.recommendation: Retain as negative evidence against universal thresholds; do not claim routing improvement.

claims.exact_claim: On a separate RTX 4090/Vulkan cohort, one-pass and cached eligibility preparation reduced median run-level P95 versus legacy two-pass at E=1k,4k,6k,100k; all rows retained oracle recall 1.0 at sparse E and 0.99998 at E=100k.
claims.hardware_software: RunPod secure cloud; AMD Ryzen 9 7950X, RTX 4090, NVIDIA driver 570.211.01, Vulkan; exact environment in archive.
claims.dataset_provenance: Retained 100k x 384 AG News source; same query/filter semantics as native cohort.
claims.timing_boundary: Completed-call host latency including eligibility preparation, transfer, execution, synchronization and result completion; build/load excluded.
claims.samples_repetitions: 5 sequential complete runs and 25000 calls per mode/cell.
claims.correctness_oracle: Independent FP64 oracle plus property tests for plan equivalence and stale-plan rejection.
claims.memory_scope: Archive contains environment/diagnostics; no cross-scope efficiency score.
claims.qualification: Qualified implementation ablation; no universal speedup claim.

claims.exact_claim: On one Linux RunPod 100k x 384 replay, Qenlo CPU P95 was 12.901 ms, FAISS Flat 10.217 ms, USearch 5.093 ms, FAISS HNSW 1.494 ms, Chroma HNSW 3.777 ms, Milvus Lite 76.229 ms, and LanceDB Flat 242.256 ms; recall ranged 0.9914--1.0.
claims.hardware_software: RunPod RTX 3070 pod; image runpod/pytorch:1.0.2-cu1281-torch280-ubuntu2404; Linux x86-64 AMD EPYC 7B12 host; GPU Vulkan unavailable, so Qenlo GPU has no timing.
claims.dataset_provenance: fancyzhx/ag_news embeddings, 100000 corpus + 100 tuning + 500 evaluation; prepared qnb SHA256 906ee4134368ce50691a2a664844d55250c33ab721c7708a6816b9caf1abe4e2.
claims.timing_boundary: Per-library completed call as defined by each replay; host API/binding/storage overhead included in external rows.
claims.samples_repetitions: 3 repetitions x 500 evaluation calls per system; 1500 samples in processed summary.
claims.correctness_oracle: Independent benchmark truth; exact rows recall 1.0, ANN rows 0.9914--0.9988 and qualified against configured target.
claims.memory_scope: No comparable memory metric; each system has its own storage/build footprint.
claims.qualification: Contextual cross-library comparison only; not product-equivalent and no GPU Qenlo measurement.
claims.limitations: Different APIs, persistence, filtering, ANN algorithms, build times, and binding boundaries; Qdrant excluded because local mode switches to exact above 20k; Vulkan failure is retained.
claims.recommendation: Retain as scoped ecosystem context and negative evidence against universal fastest-database claims; do not pool latency with native Rust/WGPU cells.

claims.exact_claim: On one Intel Arc Vulkan device-lab submission, all 21 cells report recall@10=1.0/no fallback; 100k x 384 soak exact WGPU P95 was 4.444 ms versus CPU 16.486 ms, while IVF-Flat was 2.704 ms.

claims.dataset_provenance: Device-lab deterministic clustered corpus, 10k/100k x 384; report supplied manually.
claims.timing_boundary: Host-observed completed-call device-lab P95; diagnostics include transfer and dispatch.

claims.exact_claim: On an RTX A6000, a research PyTorch/CUDA buffered prototype was slower than FAISS GPU Flat at E=1k and 10k but faster at E=100k and 1M; P95 pairs were (0.097541,0.085716), (0.155722,0.137350), (0.567277,0.788721), and (4.668280,6.347464) ms (prototype, FAISS).
claims.hardware_software: NVIDIA RTX A6000 49140 MiB, driver 570.195.03, CUDA 12.8; Python 3.12.3, PyTorch 2.9.1+cu128, FAISS 1.14.1.
claims.dataset_provenance: Synthetic normalized random FP32 vectors; fresh seed 20260903; 1M x 768; temporary eligible matrix passed to both adapters.
claims.timing_boundary: Host wall time including query H2D, device execution, synchronization, and ID D2H; setup/filter materialization excluded.
claims.samples_repetitions: 500 calls per system/cell (100 queries x 5 repetitions).
claims.correctness_oracle: Complete unordered top-10 agreement between two exact implementations; no independent FP64 oracle.
claims.memory_scope: No comparative memory metric in manifest.
claims.qualification: Qualified only as a separate research implementation-development experiment; not shipped Qenlo and not portable WGPU.
claims.limitations: Prototype API and pre-materialized eligibility; no filter-setup timing, no CPU/oracle/ANN frontier, one A6000, no native Rust CUDA.
claims.recommendation: Retain as exploratory cross-implementation reversal; never use as Qenlo product performance or pooled evidence.

claims.exact_claim: On the strict 1M x 768 TopK cohort with E=10026, FAISS GPU Flat P95 was 0.132222 ms, NumPy CPU 0.197311 ms, and a research CUDA prototype 0.170722 ms; all three qualified at recall@10=1.0, while cuVS recall 0.9 was disqualified.
claims.hardware_software: NVIDIA RTX A6000 48 GiB; driver 570.133.07; CUDA/PyTorch prototype; isolated FAISS process required cuBLASLt preload.
claims.dataset_provenance: TopK Bench public 1M x 768; strict int_filter <100, cosine via normalized FP32/IP; E=10026 due provider data distribution.
claims.timing_boundary: Host invocation through host-resident IDs/scores, including H2D query, GPU work, top-k, D2H, synchronization; excludes loading/filter construction/oracle.
claims.samples_repetitions: 5000 samples per valid row; cuVS has 0 qualified samples in strict-gate summary.
claims.correctness_oracle: Independent CPU FP64 oracle; valid rows recall 1.0; cuVS retained as failed/disqualified.
claims.qualification: Qualified exact comparative cell but research prototype, not shipped Qenlo Rust/WGPU; fails claimed 2x gate and is slower than FAISS.
claims.limitations: Only one strict selectivity, one A6000, no native Qenlo CUDA, no mobile/portable inference, process preload difference, cuVS runtime failures retained.
claims.recommendation: Retain as negative result and boundary evidence; explicitly prohibit fastest-exact-filtered-GPU claim.

claims.exact_claim: The earlier provider-compatible TopK A6000 experiment reported Qenlo CUDA prototype P95 0.1834 ms versus FAISS GPU Flat 0.1332 ms and cuVS 1.1156 ms at approximately 1% eligibility; all had supplied-ground-truth recall 1.0 in that cell.

global_limitations: Historical cohorts use different revisions, hosts, dimensions, data provenance, filters, APIs, and timing boundaries and must not be pooled.
FP32 exhaustive execution is distinct from numerical agreement with an FP64 oracle; dense native recall is 0.99998 in the retained AG News cells.
Host completed-call timings are distinct from kernel/device-resident timings; external Python/database API boundaries differ.
Process RSS, Qenlo-owned accelerator allocations, and storage budgets are distinct scopes; no invented memory-efficiency score is valid.
Android source is aggregate-only and cannot be regenerated from raw calls; several historical figures have no current generator path.
Five-run native cohorts and three-run external replays support descriptive comparisons, not broad statistical-significance claims.
